top_repeated_lines.text: happy toes begins as a father trying to reach his daughter through words.
that is the part to keep centered. before the literary experiment, there is a daughter and a father.
the book matters because it lets one private poem echo through many different voices.
and if those voices work, they should make the original feeling clearer, not bury it.
the practical test is whether the reader still feels the love underneath the structure.
